segments.headline: This is a technical test of the video pipeline
segments.en: This is a technical test of the video pipeline. It checks the voice, the music, and the captions.
segments.zh_hk: 這是影片製作流程的技術測試。它會檢查旁白、音樂及字幕。

segments.headline: Captions should follow the speech
segments.en: Each caption should appear while its words are spoken, and the music should sit quietly underneath.
segments.zh_hk: 每句字幕應在說出相應內容時出現，而背景音樂應保持輕柔。

segments.headline: The approved script will replace this text
segments.en: When the approved script is supplied, it will replace this placeholder text in a single step.
segments.zh_hk: 當獲批准的稿件提供後，只需一個步驟便可取代這段佔位文字。
